required_authority_fields.cut_utc: Root supplied exact UTC cut string
required_authority_fields.base_commit: Root supplied CP23 published commit SHA
required_authority_fields.base_tree: Root supplied CP23 published root tree SHA
required_authority_fields.previous_cut_scope: Root supplied original CP23 cut_scope bytes/SHA256/git_blob_sha1
required_authority_fields.previous_master: Root supplied original CP23 master bytes/SHA256/git_blob_sha1
required_authority_fields.inherited_root_count: Root supplied exact count independently matched against the CP23 parent

status_fields: Preserve the original seed; never infer operational acceptance from them.

archive_reference_policy.leaf: Retain original body with full UTF8 bytes/SHA256/Git verification.
archive_reference_policy.authority: Only frozen seed root lists and real canonical Git subtree cuts.
archive_reference_policy.JSON_links: Opaque; neither known nor unknown fields cause traversal or authorization.
archive_reference_policy.unknown_links: Preserved unexpanded. A new grant requires Root's explicit immutable seed.

capabilities.Git: Fixed repository; exact get blob/get tree/create blob/create tree only.
capabilities.mutation: Immutable objects/progress only; no commit/ref/PR methods.
capabilities.trees: Shallow original reads with immediate Merkle recomputation.
capabilities.blobs: Complete UTF8 body only. An explicit Root-authorized carrier may supply the same original through the blob adapter, but must pass whole original verification. No carrier is inferred from JSON.
capabilities.failure: Stop and retain failed read/pending immutable SHA; no automatic unknown write replay.

output: Collection progress and normalized packages with original leaf pins and canonical cuts. Root later supplies status, final index/cut_scope and independent lossless parent-master append.
